title: Hello, Builder
explanation: Every Java program starts in a method called main. The JVM looks for exactly that line - public static void main(String[] args) - and runs whatever sits inside its braces, top to bottom.
Each instruction ends in a semicolon. System.out.println prints into the console panel below you; Playground.say sends yourself a chat message; Playground.showTitle flashes text above your hotbar.
Anything between double quotes is just text. Change the messages, hit Run, and watch all three land at once.
